1.sahih_international: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur'an.
1.pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.
1.yusuf_ali: A. L. R. These are the Ayats of Revelation,- of a Qur'an that makes things clear.
1.shakir: Alif Lam Ra. These are the verses of the Book and (of) a Quran that makes (things) clear.
1.muhammad_sarwar: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are the verses of the Book and the glorious Quran.
1.mohsin_khan: Alif-Lam-Ra. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Quran, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. These are the Verses of the Book, and a plain Quran.
1.arberry: Alif Lam Ra. Those are the signs of the Book and of a manifest Koran.

2.sahih_international: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
2.pickthall: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.
2.yusuf_ali: Again and again will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed (to Allah's will) in Islam.
2.shakir: Often will those who disbelieve wish that they had been Muslims.
2.muhammad_sarwar: How strongly the unbelievers will wish that they had been Muslims.
2.mohsin_khan: Perhaps (often) will those who disbelieve wish that they were Muslims [those who have submitted themselves to Allah's Will in Islam Islamic Monotheism, this will be on the Day of Resurrection when they will see the disbelievers going to Hell and the Muslims going to Paradise].
2.arberry: Perchance the unbelievers will wish that they had surrendered:

3.sahih_international: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
3.pickthall: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!
3.yusuf_ali: Leave them alone, to enjoy (the good things of this life) and to please themselves: let (false) hope amuse them: soon will knowledge (undeceive them).
3.shakir: Leave them that they may eat and enjoy themselves and (that) hope may beguile them, for they will soon know.
3.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), leave them alone to eat and enjoy themselves and let their desires deceive them; they will soon know (the Truth).
3.mohsin_khan: Leave them to eat and enjoy, and let them be preoccupied with (false) hope. They will come to know!
3.arberry: leave them to eat, and to take their joy, and to be bemused by hope; certainly they will soon know!

4.sahih_international: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
4.pickthall: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.
4.yusuf_ali: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand.
4.shakir: And never did We destroy a town but it had a term made known.
4.muhammad_sarwar: We never destroyed any town without pre-ordaining the fate of its people.
4.mohsin_khan: And never did We destroy a township but there was a known decree for it.
4.arberry: Never a city have We destroyed, but it had a known decree,

5.sahih_international: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
5.pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.
5.yusuf_ali: Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it.
5.shakir: No people can hasten on their doom nor can they postpone (it).
5.muhammad_sarwar: Every nation can only live for the time appointed for it.
5.mohsin_khan: No nation can anticipate its term, nor delay it.
5.arberry: and no nation outstrips its term, nor do they put it back.

6.sahih_international: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
6.pickthall: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!
6.yusuf_ali: They say: "O thou to whom the Message is being revealed! truly thou art mad (or possessed)!
6.shakir: And they say: O you to whom the Reminder has been revealed! you are most surely insane:
6.muhammad_sarwar: (The unbelievers have said), "You to whom the Quran has been revealed are insane.
6.mohsin_khan: And they say: "O you (Muhammad SAW) to whom the Dhikr (the Quran) has been sent down! Verily, you are a mad man.
6.arberry: They say: 'Thou, upon whom the Remembrance is sent down, thou art assuredly possessed!

7.sahih_international: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
7.pickthall: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful?
7.yusuf_ali: "Why bringest thou not angels to us if it be that thou hast the Truth?"
7.shakir: Why do you not bring to us the angels if you are of the truthful ones?
7.muhammad_sarwar: Why do you not bring down the angels if what you say is true".
7.mohsin_khan: "Why do you not bring angels to us if you are of the truthful ones?"
7.arberry: Why dost thou not bring the angels unto us, if thou speakest truly?'

8.sahih_international: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and the disbelievers would not then be reprieved.
8.pickthall: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.
8.yusuf_ali: We send not the angels down except for just cause: if they came (to the ungodly), behold! no respite would they have!
8.shakir: We do not send the angels but with truth, and then they would not be respited.
8.muhammad_sarwar: We do not send down angels except for a genuine purpose, at which time none will be given any further respite.
8.mohsin_khan: We send not the angels down except with the truth (i.e. for torment, etc.), and in that case, they (the disbelievers) would have no respite!
8.arberry: We send not down the angels, save with truth;

9.sahih_international: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Qur'an and indeed, We will be its guardian.
9.pickthall: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.
9.yusuf_ali: We have, without doubt, sent down the Message; and We will assuredly guard it (from corruption).
9.shakir: Surely We have revealed the Reminder and We will most surely be its guardian.
9.muhammad_sarwar: We Ourselves have revealed the Quran and We are its Protectors.
9.mohsin_khan: Verily We: It is We Who have sent down the Dhikr (i.e. the Quran) and surely, We will guard it (from corruption).
9.arberry: then they would not be respited. It is We who have sent down the Remembrance, and We watch over it.

10.sahih_international: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
10.pickthall: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.
10.yusuf_ali: We did send messengers before thee amongst the religious sects of old:
10.shakir: And certainly We sent (apostles) before you among the nations of yore.
10.muhammad_sarwar: We sent Messengers to the ancient people who lived before you.
10.mohsin_khan: Indeed, We sent Messengers before you (O Muhammad SAW) amongst the sects (communities) of old.
10.arberry: Indeed, We sent Messengers before thee, among the factions of the ancients,

11.sahih_international: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
11.pickthall: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.
11.yusuf_ali: But never came a messenger to them but they mocked him.
11.shakir: And there never came an apostle to them but they mocked him.
11.muhammad_sarwar: No Messenger went to them whom they did not mock.
11.mohsin_khan: And never came a Messenger to them but they did mock him.
11.arberry: and not a single Messenger came to them, but they mocked at him;

12.sahih_international: Thus do We insert denial into the hearts of the criminals.
12.pickthall: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:
12.yusuf_ali: Even so do we let it creep into the hearts of the sinners -
12.shakir: Thus do We make it to enter into the hearts of the guilty;
12.muhammad_sarwar: This is how We cause the hearts of the guilty ones to behave.
12.mohsin_khan: Thus do We let it (polytheism and disbelief) enter into the hearts of the Mujrimun [criminals, polytheists, pagans, etc. (because of their mockery at the Messengers)].
12.arberry: even so We cause it to enter into the hearts of the sinners --

13.sahih_international: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
13.pickthall: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.
13.yusuf_ali: That they should not believe in the (Message); but the ways of the ancients have passed away.
13.shakir: They do not believe in it, and indeed the example of the former people has already passed.
13.muhammad_sarwar: They do not believe in the Truth and they exactly follow the tradition of the ancient (unbelievers)
13.mohsin_khan: They would not believe in it (the Quran), and already the example of (Allah's punishment of) the ancients (who disbelieved) has gone forth.
13.arberry: they believe not in it, though the wont of the ancients is already gone.

14.sahih_international: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
14.pickthall: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,
14.yusuf_ali: Even if We opened out to them a gate from heaven, and they were to continue (all day) ascending therein,
14.shakir: And even if We open to them a gateway of heaven, so that they ascend into it all the while,
14.muhammad_sarwar: Had We opened a door for them in the sky through which they could easily pass,
14.mohsin_khan: And even if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they were to continue ascending thereto,
14.arberry: Though We opened to them a gate in heaven, and still they mounted through it,

15.sahih_international: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
15.pickthall: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.
15.yusuf_ali: They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery."
15.shakir: They would certainly say: Only our eyes have been covered over, rather we are an enchanted people.
15.muhammad_sarwar: they would have said, "Our eyes are bewildered and we have been affected by magic."
15.mohsin_khan: They would surely say: "Our eyes have been (as if) dazzled. Nay, we are a people bewitched."
15.arberry: yet would they say, 'Our eyes have been dazzled; nay, we are a people bewitched!'

16.sahih_international: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
16.pickthall: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.
16.yusuf_ali: It is We Who have set out the zodiacal signs in the heavens, and made them fair-seeming to (all) beholders;
16.shakir: And certainly We have made strongholds in the heaven and We have made it fair seeming to the beholders.
16.muhammad_sarwar: We have made constellations in the sky and decorated them for the onlookers.
16.mohsin_khan: And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders.
16.arberry: We have set in heaven constellations and decked them out fair to the beholders,

17.sahih_international: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allah]
17.pickthall: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,
17.yusuf_ali: And (moreover) We have guarded them from every cursed devil:
17.shakir: And We guard it against every accursed Shaitan,
17.muhammad_sarwar: We have protected them from every condemned devil,
17.mohsin_khan: And We have guarded it (near heaven) from every outcast Shaitan (devil).
17.arberry: and guarded them from every accursed Satan

18.sahih_international: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
18.pickthall: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
18.yusuf_ali: But any that gains a hearing by stealth, is pursued by a flaming fire, bright (to see).
18.shakir: But he who steals a hearing, so there follows him a visible flame.
18.muhammad_sarwar: except for those who stealthily try to listen to the heavens, but who are chased away by a bright flame.
18.mohsin_khan: Except him (devil) that gains hearing by stealing, he is pursued by a clear flaming fire.
18.arberry: excepting such as listens by stealth -- and he is pursued by a manifest flame.

19.sahih_international: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
19.pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.
19.yusuf_ali: And the earth We have spread out (like a carpet); set thereon mountains firm and immovable; and produced therein all kinds of things in due balance.
19.shakir: And the earth-- We have spread it forth and made in it firm mountains and caused to grow in it of every suitable thing.
19.muhammad_sarwar: We have spread out the earth, fixed mountains thereupon and caused everything to grow to its proper weight
19.mohsin_khan: And the earth We spread out, and placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein all kinds of things in due proportion.
19.arberry: And the earth -- We stretched it forth, and cast on it firm mountains, and We caused to grow therein of every thing justly weighed,

20.sahih_international: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
20.pickthall: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.
20.yusuf_ali: And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible.
20.shakir: And We have made in it means of subsistence for you and for him for whom you are not the suppliers.
20.muhammad_sarwar: to provide you and those for whose sustenance you are not responsible, with the necessities of life.
20.mohsin_khan: And We have provided therein means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not [moving (living) creatures, cattle, beasts, and other animals].
20.arberry: and there appointed for you livelihood, and for those you provide not for.

21.sahih_international: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known measure.
21.pickthall: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.
21.yusuf_ali: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures.
21.shakir: And there is not a thing but with Us are the treasures of it, and We do not send it down but in a known measure.
21.muhammad_sarwar: With Us is the source of everything and We do not send it down except in a known quantity.
21.mohsin_khan: And there is not a thing, but with Us are the stores thereof. And We send it not down except in a known measure.
21.arberry: Naught is there, but its treasuries are with Us, and We send it not down but in a known measure.

22.sahih_international: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
22.pickthall: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.
22.yusuf_ali: And We send the fecundating winds, then cause the rain to descend from the sky, therewith providing you with water (in abundance), though ye are not the guardians of its stores.
22.shakir: And We send the winds fertilizing, then send down water from the cloud so We give it to you to drink of, nor is it you who store it up.
22.muhammad_sarwar: We send impregnating winds and send down water from the sky for you to drink and you have no (control over its) storage.
22.mohsin_khan: And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then caused the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We gave it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like].
22.arberry: And We loose the winds fertilising, and We send down out of heaven water, then We give it to you to drink, and you are not its treasurers.

23.sahih_international: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
23.pickthall: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.
23.yusuf_ali: And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give death: it is We Who remain inheritors (after all else passes away).
23.shakir: And most surely We bring to life and cause to die and We are the heirs.
23.muhammad_sarwar: It is We who give life and cause things to die and We are the sole Heirs.
23.mohsin_khan: And certainly We! We it is Who give life, and cause death, and We are the Inheritors.
23.arberry: It is We who give life, and make to die, and it is We who are the inheritors.

24.sahih_international: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
24.pickthall: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.
24.yusuf_ali: To Us are known those of you who hasten forward, and those who lag behind.
24.shakir: And certainly We know those of you who have gone before and We certainly know those who shall come later.
24.muhammad_sarwar: We know the people who lived before you and those who will come into existence after you.
24.mohsin_khan: And indeed, We know the first generations of you who had passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you (mankind), and also those who will come afterwards.
24.arberry: We know the ones of you who press forward, and We know the laggards;

25.sahih_international: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
25.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.
25.yusuf_ali: Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together: for He is perfect in Wisdom and Knowledge.
25.shakir: And surely your Lord will gather them together; surely He is Wise, Knowing.
25.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord will resurrect them all; He is All-wise and All-knowing.
25.mohsin_khan: And verily, your Lord will gather them together. Truly, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.
25.arberry: and it is thy Lord shall muster them, and He is All-wise, All-knowing.

26.sahih_international: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
26.pickthall: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,
26.yusuf_ali: We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape;
26.shakir: And certainly We created man of clay that gives forth sound, of black mud fashioned in shape.
26.muhammad_sarwar: We have created the human being out of pure mud-moulded clay
26.mohsin_khan: And indeed, We created man from sounding clay of altered black smooth mud.
26.arberry: Surely We created man of a clay of mud moulded,

27.sahih_international: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
27.pickthall: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.
27.yusuf_ali: And the Jinn race, We had created before, from the fire of a scorching wind.
27.shakir: And the jinn We created before, of intensely hot fire.
27.muhammad_sarwar: and the jinn before (the human being) of smokeless fire.
27.mohsin_khan: And the jinn, We created aforetime from the smokeless flame of fire.
27.arberry: and the jinn created We before of fire flaming.

28.sahih_international: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
28.pickthall: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,
28.yusuf_ali: Behold! thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man, from sounding clay from mud moulded into shape;
28.shakir: And when your Lord said to the angels: Surely I am going to create a mortal of the essence of black mud fashioned in shape.
28.muhammad_sarwar: When your Lord said to the angels, "I will create the human being out of pure mud-moulded clay.
28.mohsin_khan: And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "I am going to create a man (Adam) from sounding clay of altered black smooth mud.
28.arberry: And when thy Lord said to the angels, 'See, I am creating a mortal of a clay of mud moulded.

29.sahih_international: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
29.pickthall: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.
29.yusuf_ali: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
29.shakir: So when I have made him complete and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down making obeisance to him.
29.muhammad_sarwar: When it is properly shaped and I have blown My Spirit into it, you should then bow down in prostration".
29.mohsin_khan: "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves unto him."
29.arberry: When I have shaped him, and breathed My spirit in him, fall you down, bowing before him!'

30.sahih_international: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
30.pickthall: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together
30.yusuf_ali: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
30.shakir: So the angels made obeisance, all of them together,
30.muhammad_sarwar: All the angels prostrated before Adam
30.mohsin_khan: So, the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together.
30.arberry: Then the angels bowed themselves all together,

31.sahih_international: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.
31.pickthall: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.
31.yusuf_ali: Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
31.shakir: But Iblis (did it not); he refused to be with those who made obeisance.
31.muhammad_sarwar: except Iblis who refused to join with the others in prostration.
31.mohsin_khan: Except Iblis (Satan), - he refused to be among the prostrators.
31.arberry: save Iblis; he refused to be among those bowing.

32.sahih_international: [Allah] said, O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
32.pickthall: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate?
32.yusuf_ali: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! what is your reason for not being among those who prostrated themselves?"
32.shakir: He said: O Iblis! what excuse have you that you are not with those who make obeisance?
32.muhammad_sarwar: God asked Iblis, "What made you not join the others in prostration?"
32.mohsin_khan: (Allah) said: "O Iblis (Satan)! What is your reason for not being among the prostrators?"
32.arberry: Said He, 'What ails thee, Iblis, that thou art not among those bowing?'

33.sahih_international: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
33.pickthall: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!
33.yusuf_ali: (Iblis) said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to man, whom Thou didst create from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape."
33.shakir: He said: I am not such that I should make obeisance to a mortal whom Thou hast created of the essence of black mud fashioned in shape.
33.muhammad_sarwar: Iblis replied, "I did not want to prostrate before a human being whom You have created out of mud-moulded clay".
33.mohsin_khan: [Iblis (Satan)] said: "I am not the one to prostrate myself to a human being, whom You created from sounding clay of altered black smooth mud."
33.arberry: Said he, 'I would never bow myself before a mortal whom Thou hast created of a clay of mud moulded.'

34.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.
34.pickthall: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.
34.yusuf_ali: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here; for thou art rejected, accursed.
34.shakir: He said: Then get out of it, for surely you are driven away:
34.muhammad_sarwar: God told him, "Get out of the garden; you are rejected
34.mohsin_khan: (Allah) said: "Then, get out from here, for verily, you are Rajim (an outcast or a cursed one)." [Tafsir At-Tabari]
34.arberry: Said He, 'Then go thou forth hence; thou art accursed.

35.sahih_international: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
35.pickthall: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.
35.yusuf_ali: "And the curse shall be on thee till the day of Judgment."
35.shakir: And surely on you is curse until the day of judgment.
35.muhammad_sarwar: and will be subjected to condemnation until the Day of Judgment."
35.mohsin_khan: "And verily, the curse shall be upon you till the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)."
35.arberry: Upon thee shall rest the curse, till the Day of Doom.'

36.sahih_international: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
36.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
36.yusuf_ali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
36.shakir: He said: My Lord! then respite me till the time when they are raised.
36.muhammad_sarwar: Iblis prayed, "Lord, grant me respite until the Day of Judgment".
36.mohsin_khan: [Iblis (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected."
36.arberry: Said he, 'My Lord, respite me till the day they shall be raised.'

37.sahih_international: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
37.pickthall: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved
37.shakir: He said: So surely you are of the respited ones
37.muhammad_sarwar: The Lord said, "Your request is granted
37.mohsin_khan: Allah said: "Then, verily, you are of those reprieved,
37.arberry: Said He, 'Thou art among the ones that are respited

38.sahih_international: Until the Day of the time well-known."
38.pickthall: Till the Day of appointed time.
38.yusuf_ali: "Till the Day of the Time appointed."
38.shakir: Till the period of the time made known.
38.mohsin_khan: "Till the Day of the time appointed."
38.arberry: unto the day of a known time.'

39.sahih_international: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
39.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,
39.yusuf_ali: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! because Thou hast put me in the wrong, I will make (wrong) fair-seeming to them on the earth, and I will put them all in the wrong,-
39.shakir: He said: My Lord! because Thou hast made life evil to me, I will certainly make (evil) fair-seeming to them on earth, and I will certainly cause them all to deviate

80.arberry: The dwellers in El-Hijr cried lies to the Envoys.

81.sahih_international: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
81.pickthall: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.
81.yusuf_ali: We sent them Our Signs, but they persisted in turning away from them.
81.shakir: And We gave them Our communications, but they turned aside from them;
81.muhammad_sarwar: We showed them miracles but they ignored them.
81.mohsin_khan: And We gave them Our Signs, but they were averse to them.
81.arberry: We brought them. Our signs, and they turned away from them.

82.sahih_international: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
82.pickthall: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.
82.yusuf_ali: Out of the mountains did they hew (their) edifices, (feeling themselves) secure.
82.shakir: And they hewed houses in the mountains in security.
82.muhammad_sarwar: They would carve secure houses out of the mountains.
82.mohsin_khan: And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains (feeling themselves) secure.
82.arberry: They were hewing the mountains into houses, therein dwelling securely;

83.sahih_international: But the shriek seized them at early morning.
83.pickthall: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,
83.yusuf_ali: But the (mighty) Blast seized them of a morning,
83.shakir: So the rumbling overtook them in the morning;
83.muhammad_sarwar: An explosion struck them in the morning.
83.mohsin_khan: But As-Saihah (torment - awful cry etc.) overtook them in the early morning (of the fourth day of their promised punishment days).
83.arberry: and the Cry seized them in the morning;

84.sahih_international: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
84.pickthall: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.
84.yusuf_ali: And of no avail to them was all that they did (with such art and care)!
84.shakir: And what they earned did not avail them.
84.muhammad_sarwar: Out of what they had gained, nothing proved to be of any benefit to them.
84.mohsin_khan: And all that which they used to earn availed them not.
84.arberry: that they earned did not avail them.

85.sahih_international: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
85.pickthall: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.
85.yusuf_ali: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, but for just ends. And the Hour is surely coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) with gracious forgiveness.
85.shakir: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them two but in truth; and the hour is most surely coming, so turn away with kindly forgiveness.
85.muhammad_sarwar: We have created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, for a genuine purpose. The Day of Judgment will certainly approach, so (Muhammad) forgive them graciously.
85.mohsin_khan: And We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and the Hour is surely coming, so overlook (O Muhammad SAW), their faults with gracious forgiveness. [This was before the ordainment of Jihad holy fighting in Allah's Cause].
85.arberry: We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, save in truth. Surely the Hour is coming; so pardon thou, with a gracious pardoning.

86.sahih_international: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
86.pickthall: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.
86.yusuf_ali: For verily it is thy Lord who is the Master-Creator, knowing all things.
86.shakir: Surely your Lord is the Creator of all things, the Knowing.
86.muhammad_sarwar: Your Lord is certainly the All-knowing Creator.
86.mohsin_khan: Verily, your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator.
86.arberry: Surely thy Lord, He is the All-creator, the All-knowing.

87.sahih_international: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.
87.pickthall: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.
87.yusuf_ali: And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur'an.
87.shakir: And certainly We have given you seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the grand Quran.
87.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), We have given you the seven most repeated (verses) and the great Quran.
87.mohsin_khan: And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of Al-Mathani (the seven repeatedly recited Verses), (i.e. Surat Al-Fatiha) and the Grand Quran.
87.arberry: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated, and the mighty Koran.

88.sahih_international: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
88.pickthall: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.
88.yusuf_ali: Strain not thine eyes. (Wistfully) at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them, nor grieve over them: but lower thy wing (in gentleness) to the believers.
88.shakir: Do not strain your eyes after what We have given certain classes of them to enjoy, and do not grieve for them, and make yourself gentle to the believers.
88.muhammad_sarwar: Do not yearn for other people's property and wives and do not grieve (that they do not believe). Be kind to the believers.
88.mohsin_khan: Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them (the disbelievers), nor grieve over them. And lower your wings for the believers (be courteous to the fellow-believers).
88.arberry: Stretch not thine eyes to that We have given pairs of them to enjoy; and do not sorrow for them, and lower thy wing unto the believers,

89.sahih_international: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
89.pickthall: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,
89.yusuf_ali: And say: "I am indeed he that warneth openly and without ambiguity,"-
89.shakir: And say: Surely I am the plain warner.
89.muhammad_sarwar: Say, "Indeed, I am simply one who warns."
89.mohsin_khan: And say: "I am indeed a plain warner."
89.arberry: and say, 'Surely, I am the manifest warner.'

90.sahih_international: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
90.pickthall: Such as We send down for those who make division,
90.yusuf_ali: (Of just such wrath) as We sent down on those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts),-
90.shakir: Like as We sent down on the dividers
90.muhammad_sarwar: (We have given you the Quran) as We had given (the Bible) to those who divided themselves into groups
90.mohsin_khan: As We have sent down on the dividers, (Quraish pagans or Jews and Christians).
90.arberry: So We sent it down to the partitioners,

91.sahih_international: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.
91.pickthall: Those who break the Qur'an into parts.
91.yusuf_ali: (So also on such) as have made Qur'an into shreds (as they please).
91.shakir: Those who made the Quran into shreds.
91.muhammad_sarwar: and also divided the Quran believing in some parts and rejecting others.
91.mohsin_khan: Who have made the Quran into parts. (i.e. believed in a part and disbelieved in the other).
91.arberry: who have broken the Koran into fragments.

92.sahih_international: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
92.pickthall: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,
92.yusuf_ali: Therefore, by the Lord, We will, of a surety, call them to account,
92.shakir: So, by your Lord, We would most certainly question them all,
92.muhammad_sarwar: By the Lord, We will hold them all responsible
92.mohsin_khan: So, by your Lord (O Muhammad SAW), We shall certainly call all of them to account.
92.arberry: Now by thy Lord, We shall surely question them all together

93.sahih_international: About what they used to do.
93.pickthall: Of what they used to do.
93.mohsin_khan: For all that they used to do.

94.sahih_international: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
94.pickthall: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.
94.yusuf_ali: Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with Allah.
94.shakir: Therefore declare openly what you are bidden and turn aside from the polytheists.
94.muhammad_sarwar: Preach what you have been commanded to and stay away from the pagans.
94.mohsin_khan: Therefore proclaim openly (Allah's Message Islamic Monotheism) that which you are commanded, and turn away from Al-Mushrikun (polytheists, idolaters, and disbelievers, etc. - see V. 2:105).
94.arberry: So shout that thou art commanded and turn thou away from the idolaters.

95.sahih_international: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
95.pickthall: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,
95.yusuf_ali: For sufficient are We unto thee against those who scoff,-
95.shakir: Surely We will suffice you against the scoffers
95.muhammad_sarwar: We shall help you against those who mock you
95.mohsin_khan: Truly! We will suffice you against the scoffers.
95.arberry: We suffice thee against the mockers,

96.sahih_international: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.
96.pickthall: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.
96.yusuf_ali: Those who adopt, with Allah, another god: but soon will they come to know.
96.shakir: Those who set up another god with Allah; so they shall soon know.
96.muhammad_sarwar: and believe other things to be equal to God. They will soon know the truth.
96.mohsin_khan: Who set up along with Allah another ilah (god), they will come to know.
96.arberry: even against those who set up with God another god. Certainly they will soon know!

97.sahih_international: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
97.pickthall: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,
97.yusuf_ali: We do indeed know how thy heart is distressed at what they say.
97.shakir: And surely We know that your breast straitens at what they say;
97.muhammad_sarwar: We certainly know that you feel sad about what they say against you.
97.mohsin_khan: Indeed, We know that your breast is straitened at what they say.
97.arberry: We know indeed thy breast is straitened by the things they say.

98.sahih_international: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
98.pickthall: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).
98.yusuf_ali: But celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves in adoration.
98.shakir: Therefore celebrate the praise of your Lord, and be of those who make obeisance.
98.muhammad_sarwar: Glorify and praise your Lord and be with those who prostrate themselves before God.
98.mohsin_khan: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be of those who prostrate themselves (to Him).
98.arberry: Proclaim thy Lord's praise, and be of those that bow,

99.sahih_international: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
99.pickthall: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.
99.yusuf_ali: And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain.
99.shakir: And serve your Lord until there comes to you that which is certain.
99.muhammad_sarwar: Worship your Lord until you achieve the ultimate certainty.
99.mohsin_khan: And worship your Lord until there comes unto you the certainty (i.e. death).
99.arberry: and serve thy Lord, until the Certain comes to thee.
